reel_hook: Nvidia just lost its founder CEO.

slides.title: Nvidia's Huang steps down
slides.image_prompt: Empty leather executive chair at the head of a long dark boardroom table, a glowing green microchip resting on the table, dramatic side light
slides.label: TECHNOLOGY
points: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO, effective immediately.
CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO; no reason was given.
Hold Nvidia or AI funds? Watch its quarterly results on Tuesday 17 Nov.
slides.body: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO, effective immediately. CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO; no reason was given. Hold Nvidia or AI funds? Watch its quarterly results on Tuesday 17 Nov.

slides.title: Iran, US clash over Bahrain
slides.image_prompt: Military radar dish on a desert coastline at dusk, two small unmarked drone silhouettes in an orange sky over calm sea
slides.label: WORLD
points: Iran says it destroyed a US radar in Bahrain.
The US says it shot down two drones, no damage.
Neither account is independently verified, so treat early war claims with care.
slides.body: Iran says it destroyed a US radar in Bahrain. The US says it shot down two drones, no damage. Neither account is independently verified, so treat early war claims with care.

slides.title: Tanker blasts in Hormuz
slides.image_prompt: Large gas tanker ship on a dark sea with a plume of smoke rising, a spherical naval mine floating in the foreground waves
slides.label: ECONOMY
points: Iran says an LNG tanker hit a mine near Hormuz.
Iranian media say four oil tankers were also hit.
More risk on this shipping route can push up energy prices; watch fuel bills.
slides.body: Iran says an LNG tanker hit a mine near Hormuz. Iranian media say four oil tankers were also hit. More risk on this shipping route can push up energy prices; watch fuel bills.
